message: Every single star in the sky tonight is shining a little brighter because of you. You came into this world and quietly made everything softer, kinder, and more beautiful. Happy birthday, gem. The universe is genuinely lucky to have you in it.

There are a thousand little moments I keep folded up in my heart — the way you laugh when something really gets you, the way you care so deeply about people who can't always see it. I wanted you to know: I see it. I always have. Happy birthday.

You are allowed to take up space. You are allowed to feel joy without guilt, to rest without shame, to celebrate yourself without needing a reason beyond simply existing. Today is your reason. You are your reason. I hope this birthday feels like a long exhale.

If I could wrap up one feeling and give it to you, it would be the warmth of a late afternoon when nothing is wrong and everything is golden. That's what you deserve every day. But especially today. Happy birthday.

We don't say it enough. You are extraordinary — not because of what you do or how much you produce, but because of who you ARE. The way you move through this world with so much heart. We are so grateful you were born. Happy birthday.

preview: 🌊 A Wish for the Year Ahead
message: May this next year bring you something that surprises you. A door you didn't expect, a connection that fills you up, a moment so quiet and perfect that you press it into your memory like a flower between pages. You deserve a beautiful year.

Okay, real talk: you are one of the good ones. Genuinely. The kind of person the world needs more of. So today, on the anniversary of the best decision the cosmos ever made — we celebrate YOU. Eat something delicious. Feel loved. You are.

I was thinking about all the ways you've made my life better and I ran out of fingers to count on. So I'm writing this down instead. You matter more than you know. Sleep well, shine bright, and happy birthday, always.
